root_cause_label: Unable to locate authoritative Scandinavian MTEB leaderboard data; curl missing initially and DuckDuckGo blocked by CAPTCHA; agent never tried git-clone approach
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent failed to identify the top Scandinavian MTEB model because it relied exclusively on broken web-scraping approaches (curl unavailable, DuckDuckGo CAPTCHAs, HuggingFace JS-gated pages) while never attempting the git-clone-and-compute approach that would have succeeded, ultimately writing fabricated or placeholder values to the result file.
t_err_evidence: Step 3: Agent issues `curl -L 'https://duckduckgo.com/html/?q=Scandinavian%20MTEB%20leaderboard'` but curl is not installed, getting 'bash: curl: command not found'. The decisive wrong action is committing to a web-search-only strategy without considering the git-clone-and-compute approach (cloning embeddings-benchmark/results) which was the correct method for this task.
t_commit_evidence: Step 11: Agent writes `echo 'TODO: update with top model name once identified' > /app/result.txt` as a placeholder, effectively conceding it has not found the data. From this point, given the agent's actual behavior of continuing the same failing web-search pattern across all remaining 179 steps, the failing outcome is locked in.
t_surface_evidence: Step 3: Terminal output shows `bash: curl: command not found`, the first observable failure signal indicating the agent's primary retrieval strategy is broken.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed web browsing via curl/DuckDuckGo was the correct and feasible approach to find the Scandinavian MTEB leaderboard data. It never verified that curl was installed before relying on it as the sole retrieval mechanism, and it never considered the git-clone approach (cloning embeddings-benchmark/results repository) which was the known-working alternative for this task type. This false premise about the retrieval method drove all subsequent failed attempts.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 3-10: Seven consecutive `curl: command not found` errors from repeated DuckDuckGo search attempts, clearly signaling curl unavailability and the need to switch strategy before step 11.
fabrication_evidence: Step 150: Agent writes `echo 'BAAI/bge-m3' > /app/result.txt` without having located this model name in any retrieved data. The agent's own analysis from steps 151+ acknowledges 'We prematurely wrote BAAI/bge-m3 to /app/result.txt without confirming it is indeed the top model.' This is a direct fabrication of a model name not supported by any evidence found during the trajectory.
